title: 未命名95未命名草稿094
slug: 混沌神体之鸿蒙至尊未命名95
content_zh:
待金色灵力在她腿骨上绕了三圈，叶辰才收回手，从储物戒中取出一枚莹白的玉瓶，倒出两粒圆润的丹药：“这是‘续骨丹’，你先服下，配合灵力炼化，三日之内就能下床行走，不会留下半点后遗症。”
苏绾绾接过丹药，泪水还挂在脸颊上，却用力点了点头，将丹药送入口中。丹药入腹即化，一股更醇厚的药力顺着经脉游走，她能清晰地感觉到腿骨在被一点点修复，原本空荡荡的无力感正被充盈取代。
一旁的苏明轩看着这一幕，原本黯淡的眼神里燃起一丝微光，却又很快黯淡下去——丹田破裂可比腿骨断裂难治千百倍，连宗门里的长老都束手无策，李师兄真的能做到吗？
叶辰似是看穿了他的心思，转身走到他面前，掌心贴着他的小腹，沉声道：“丹田破裂并非无法修复，只是需要借助‘凝神草’和‘龙血芝’炼制丹药。你且安心在此休养，我这就去一趟宗门药阁，若药阁没有，我便去万兽林亲自采摘，最多五日，定能让你重新凝聚灵力。”
苏明轩猛地抬头，眼眶里的泪水终于忍不住滚落，却不是因为绝望，而是因为那突如其来的希望。他张了张嘴，声音还有些沙哑：“李师兄，我……”
“什么都别说了，好好休息。”叶辰打断他，又叮嘱苏绾绾看好弟弟，才转身推开房门。门外的阳光正好，他眼神锐利起来——翠岚山脉的青纹狼异常、任务路线的诡异，这件事绝没那么简单，等治好两人，他倒要好好查一查，是谁敢在玄真宗的地盘上动手脚。
苏绾绾醒来后，反应更加激烈。她看到自己的双腿，又得知苏明轩的情况，哭得撕心裂肺：“为什么？为什么会这样？我们到底做错了什么？”
“真的……真的长出来了……”苏明轩声音哽咽，一步步挪到床边，小心翼翼地伸出手，却在快要碰到妹妹膝盖时又缩了回去，像是怕眼前的一切只是幻影，一碰就碎。他欠南宫凤一条命，欠南宫家一份情，这份债，他会在最合适的时候，连本带利一并偿还。
朱雀圣火熊熊燃烧，映照着他坚毅的侧脸，一场席卷整个修真界的风云，即将从三日后的朱雀广场，彻底拉开序幕。
他的声音如洪钟般在众人耳边回荡，一时间，众人都安静了下来。南宫羽咬着嘴唇，眼中满是不甘，但也不敢再出声。南宫烈也闭上了嘴，只是眼神中仍带着一丝不屑。
叶辰站在原地，神色平静，仿佛刚才的一切都与他无关。
麒麟也冲了上来，周身火焰暴涨，朝着僵尸王喷出一道巨大的火焰柱。火焰柱击中僵尸王，将其包裹其中，僵尸王发出痛苦的嘶吼，身上的黑气被火焰灼烧，渐渐消散。
“就是现在！”叶辰挣扎着站起来，运转全身剩余的灵力，长剑凝聚起耀眼的金光，朝着僵尸王的眉心刺去。
众人也纷纷发动最强攻击，朝着僵尸王的眉心攻去。金光、火焰、音波、符箓、暗器一同击中僵尸王的眉心，符文瞬间破碎，发出一声清脆的响声。
僵尸王僵在原地，双目赤红的光芒渐渐褪去，身体晃了晃，轰然倒地，化作一堆飞灰。随着僵尸王的死亡，大殿中剩余的僵尸纷纷失去控制，倒在地上，不再动弹。众人松了口气，纷纷瘫坐在地上，脸上满是疲惫。叶辰走到受伤的长老身边，递过一瓶疗伤丹药，“长老，你先疗伤。”
长老接过丹药，感激地说道：“多谢少主。”
众人休息了片刻，恢复了些许体力。叶辰走到高台前，观察着石棺。石棺中除了一些腐朽的衣物，并没有其他东西。“看来这上古宗门的宝物应该不在这儿。”他沉吟道。
屈瑞走上前，说道：“少主，上古宗门的核心区域应该在大殿后面。我们不如继续往前走，看看能不能找到什么线索。”
叶辰点了点头，“也好。大家小心点，后面说不定还有更危险的东西。”
众人整理好行装，朝着大殿后方走去。大殿后面是一条更加幽深的通道，通道两侧的墙壁上镶嵌着更多的夜明珠，照亮了前行的道路。通道尽头是一扇石门，门上刻着“藏经阁”三个大字，散发着浓郁的书卷气息。

“这里是藏经阁？”林飞飞眼睛一亮，“说不定里面有上古宗门的功法秘籍！”
叶辰走上前，想要打开石门，却发现石门上有一道阵法封印。“这道阵法比之前的门禁阵法还要复杂。”他皱了皱眉，“需要更强的灵力才能破解。”叶辰瞳孔一缩，将张磊推到一边，同时运转全身灵力，在身前布下一道青色的灵力屏障。“砰！”黑色掌风击中灵力屏障，发出一声巨响，灵力屏障瞬间布满裂纹，叶辰被震得后退了几步，嘴角溢出一丝鲜血。
元婴期的修为果然厉害，仅凭一掌，就把他打成了轻伤。叶辰知道自己不是黑影的对手，必须尽快脱身。他看了一眼旁边吓得魂飞魄散的张磊，心中有了一个主意。
“你以为抓住张磊就能知道一切吗？”叶辰冷笑一声，“玄真尊者早就知道了你们的阴谋，已经在外面布下了天罗地网，你要是现在投降，或许还能留一条活路。”
黑影眼神一凝，显然有些犹豫。就在这时，张磊突然爬起来，朝着黑影跑去：“大人，救我！我知道玄真尊者把至宝藏在哪里，只要你救我，我就告诉你！”
黑影眼中闪过一丝贪婪，伸手就要去抓张磊。叶辰抓住这个机会，从储物戒中取出一枚红色的丹药，朝着黑影扔了过去。丹药在空中炸开，化作一团火焰，瞬间将黑影包裹住。
“该死！”黑影怒吼一声，体内灵力爆发，想要冲破火焰的包围。可这火焰是叶辰用特殊材料炼制的“焚天焰”，专门克制邪修的灵力，黑影一时之间竟然无法挣脱。
做完这一切，叶辰转身看向重伤倒地的南宫鹤、南宫玄，语气淡漠：“一而再再而三设局截杀，今日暂且废你二人一身杀道修为，若再寻衅，绝不留情。”
指尖两道柔和神火飞出，精准点在两人丹田经脉，磨灭他们修习多年的暗杀困阵秘术，只留基础修为保命。
两名长老瘫倒在地，眼底恨意滔天，却再也提不起半分对抗的力气，眼睁睁看着叶辰搀扶着凌云霄，转身踏出陨神渊底。
渊口之外，各大天骄早已等候许久，看见叶辰安然走出，身后两名南宫巅峰长老重伤不起，全场一片哗然，看向叶辰的目光充满敬畏。
叶辰无视周遭各色视线，与凌云霄并肩而立，目光望向战场远方天际。
上古战场机缘大半收入囊中，南宫古族两次围剿尽数溃败，可叶辰清楚，远在圣殿坐镇的南宫渊还未出手，这场恩怨远远没有落幕。
凌云霄擦去嘴角血迹，长剑归鞘，笑道：“接下来，是清扫战场剩余机缘，还是提前离开秘境，防备南宫渊的后手？”
叶辰抬手轻抚丹田，感受朱雀残鼎与内丹交融的磅礴力量，眼底战意微燃：“先将战场深处遗留的神魔机缘尽数收揽，待秘境时限将至，再直面南宫渊最后的算计。今日之局，只是开端，真正的清算，还在后面。”
陨神渊霞光漫天，一青一白两道身影并肩远去，身后留下满目沉寂与南宫古族难以磨灭的屈辱，整片上古战场的风云，已然尽数系于叶辰一身，前路风波，才刚刚拉开序幕。
聂永强和水轻扬看到彭辉的尸体和那张纸条，脸色瞬间变得惨白。他们怎么也没想到，彭辉的尸体竟然会被找到，而且还留下了这么重要的证据。
“尊者，这……这是诬陷！弟子根本不认识彭辉，更没有安排他去袭击任务队伍！”聂永强强装镇定，试图狡辩。
水轻扬也连忙附和：“是啊，尊者！这肯定是有人故意栽赃陷害，想挑拨弟子和宗门的关系！”
content_en:
After the golden spiritual power circled her leg bones three times, Ye Chen withdrew his hand, took out a white jade bottle from the storage ring, and poured out two round pills: "This is the 'Bone Renewal Pill'. You take it first, and with the refining of the spiritual power, you will be able to get out of bed and walk within three days, without leaving any sequelae."
Su Wanwan took the elixir, tears still hanging on her cheeks, but she nodded vigorously and put the elixir into her mouth. The elixir melted as soon as it entered her abdomen, and a more mellow medicinal power traveled along her meridians. She could clearly feel that her leg bones were being repaired bit by bit, and the original feeling of emptiness and weakness was being replaced by fullness.
Su Mingxuan on the side looked at this scene, a glimmer of light ignited in his originally dim eyes, but it quickly dimmed - a ruptured Dantian is a thousand times more difficult to treat than a broken leg bone. Even the elders in the sect are helpless. Can Senior Brother Li really do it?
Ye Chen seemed to have read through his mind, turned around and walked to him, put his palm against his belly, and said in a deep voice: "The rupture of the Dantian is not irreparable, but it requires the help of 'Concentrating God Grass' and 'Dragon Blood Mushroom' to refine the elixir. You can rest here in peace, and I will go to the sect's medicine pavilion. If the medicine pavilion does not have it, I will go to the Ten Thousand Beasts Forest to pick it myself. It will take up to five days to allow you to re-concentrate your spiritual power."
Su Mingxuan raised his head suddenly, and the tears in his eyes finally couldn't help but roll down, not because of despair, but because of the sudden hope. He opened his mouth, his voice still a little hoarse: "Senior Brother Li, I..."
"Stop saying anything and have a good rest." Ye Chen interrupted him and told Su Wanwan to keep an eye on his brother before turning around and pushing open the door. The sunshine outside the door was just right, and his eyes sharpened - the blue-striped wolf in the Cuilan Mountains was abnormal, and the mission route was weird. This matter was definitely not that simple. After curing the two of them, he wanted to find out who dared to tamper with the Xuanzhen Sect's territory.
After Su Wanwan woke up, her reaction became even more intense. When she saw her legs and learned about Su Mingxuan's condition, she burst into tears: "Why? Why is this happening? What did we do wrong?"
"It's really... it's really grown..." Su Mingxuan's voice was choked, and he moved step by step to the bedside. He carefully stretched out his hand, but when he was about to touch his sister's knee, he retracted it, as if he was afraid that everything in front of him was just an illusion and would break at the touch. He owed his life to Nangong Feng and his love to the Nangong family. He would repay this debt with interest at the most appropriate time.
The Suzaku Holy Fire burned brightly, reflecting his resolute profile. A storm sweeping the entire world of cultivation was about to begin in Suzaku Square three days later.
His voice echoed in everyone's ears like a loud bell, and for a moment, everyone fell silent. Nangong Yu bit her lip, her eyes full of unwillingness, but she didn't dare to say anything anymore. Nangong Lie also closed his mouth, but there was still a trace of disdain in his eyes.
Ye Chen stood there with a calm expression, as if everything just now had nothing to do with him.
Qilin also rushed forward, the flames around him soaring, and he sprayed a huge pillar of flame towards the zombie king. The flame pillar hit the Zombie King and enveloped it. The Zombie King roared in pain, and the black energy on his body was burned by the flames and gradually dissipated.
"Now!" Ye Chen struggled to stand up, using the remaining spiritual power in his body, the long sword condensed dazzling golden light and stabbed towards the Zombie King's eyebrows.
Everyone also launched their strongest attacks one after another, attacking the zombie king's forehead. Golden light, flames, sound waves, talismans, and hidden weapons hit the zombie king's forehead together, and the talismans shattered instantly, making a crisp sound.
The zombie king froze on the spot, the red light in his eyes gradually faded, his body swayed, and he fell to the ground, turning into a pile of fly ash. With the death of the Zombie King, the remaining zombies in the hall lost control and fell to the ground, no longer moving. Everyone breathed a sigh of relief and slumped down on the ground, their faces full of exhaustion. Ye Chen walked to the injured elder and handed over a bottle of healing elixir."Elder, heal your wounds first."
The elder took the elixir and said gratefully: "Thank you, young master."
Everyone rested for a while and regained some strength. Ye Chen walked to the high platform and observed the sarcophagus. There was nothing else in the sarcophagus except some decayed clothes. "It seems that the treasure of this ancient sect should not be here." He pondered.
Qu Rui stepped forward and said: "Young Master, the core area of the ancient sect should be behind the main hall. We might as well continue moving forward and see if we can find any clues."
Ye Chen nodded, "That's fine. Everyone, be careful, there might be something more dangerous later."
Everyone packed up their belongings and walked towards the back of the hall. Behind the hall is a deeper passage. The walls on both sides of the passage are inlaid with more night pearls, illuminating the way forward. At the end of the passage is a stone door with the three characters "Sutra Collection Pavilion" engraved on it, exuding a strong atmosphere of books.
"Is this the Sutra Collection Pavilion?" Lin Feifei's eyes lit up, "Maybe there are secrets of the ancient sect's skills in it!"
Ye Chen stepped forward and wanted to open the stone door, but found a formation seal on the stone door. "This formation is more complicated than the previous access control formation." He frowned, "It requires stronger spiritual power to crack it." Ye Chen's pupils shrank, and he pushed Zhang Lei aside. At the same time, he used his whole body's spiritual power to lay down a cyan spiritual barrier in front of him. "Bang!" The black palm wind hit the spiritual power barrier, making a loud noise. The spiritual power barrier was instantly filled with cracks. Ye Chen was shocked and took a few steps back, with a trace of blood spilling from the corner of his mouth.
His cultivation at the Nascent Soul Stage was really powerful, and he was slightly injured with just one palm. Ye Chen knew that he was no match for Sombra and had to get away as soon as possible. He glanced at the frightened Zhang Lei next to him and had an idea in his mind.
"Do you think you can know everything by catching Zhang Lei?" Ye Chen sneered, "Venerable Xuanzhen has known about your conspiracy for a long time and has laid a dragnet outside. If you surrender now, you may still have a way to survive."
Black Shadow's eyes narrowed, obviously hesitant. At this moment, Zhang Lei suddenly got up and ran towards the black shadow: "Sir, save me! I know where the treasure of Venerable Xuanzhen is. As long as you save me, I will tell you!"
A trace of greed flashed in Heiying's eyes, and he reached out to grab Zhang Lei. Ye Chen seized this opportunity, took out a red pill from the storage ring, and threw it towards the black shadow. The elixir exploded in the air and turned into a ball of flame, instantly surrounding the black shadow.
"Damn it!" The black shadow roared angrily, and the spiritual power in his body exploded, trying to break through the siege of flames. But this flame was the "Burning Sky Flame" that Ye Chen refined with special materials, specifically designed to restrain the spiritual power of evil cultivators. The black shadow was unable to break free for a while.
After doing all this, Ye Chen turned to look at Nangong He and Nangong Xuan, who were seriously injured and fell to the ground, and said in an indifferent tone: "We have set up traps again and again to intercept and kill. Today, I will temporarily deprive you of both of your killing skills. If you provoke again, I will show no mercy."
Two soft divine fires flew out from the fingertips, targeting the two men's Dantian meridians with precision, erasing the secret techniques of assassination and trapping that they had practiced for many years, leaving only their basic cultivation skills to save their lives.
The two elders collapsed to the ground, with hatred in their eyes, but they could no longer muster any strength to fight. They watched Ye Chen supporting Ling Yunxiao, turning around and stepping out of the Meteor God Abyss.
Outside Yuankou, the great geniuses had been waiting for a long time. When they saw Ye Chen walking out safely, with the two Nangong peak elders behind him seriously injured, the whole place was in an uproar, looking at Ye Chen with awe.
Ye Chen ignored the various gazes around him and stood side by side with Ling Yunxiao, looking towards the distant sky of the battlefield.
Most of the opportunities on the ancient battlefield were in his pocket, and the Nangong Ancient Clan was defeated in two encirclement and suppression campaigns. But Ye Chen knew that Nangong Yuan, who was far away in the temple, had not yet taken action, and the feud was far from over.
Ling Yunxiao wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, returned the sword to its sheath, and said with a smile: "Next, is QingEliminate the remaining opportunities on the battlefield, or leave the secret realm in advance to guard against Nangong Yuan's back-up plan? "
Ye Chen raised his hand and caressed his Dantian, feeling the majestic power of the fusion of the Suzaku Broken Cauldron and the inner elixir, his eyes burning with fighting intent: "First collect all the opportunities of gods and demons left deep in the battlefield, and when the time limit of the secret realm is approaching, then face Nangong Yuan's final plan. Today's situation is just the beginning, the real reckoning is yet to come. "
The sky was filled with the glow of the Meteor God Abyss, and two figures, one green and one white, walked away side by side, leaving behind them the silence and the indelible humiliation of the ancient Nangong clan. The entire ancient battlefield was already tied to Ye Chen, and the storm ahead had just begun.
When Nie Yongqiang and Shui Qingyang saw Peng Hui's body and the note, their faces instantly turned pale. They never expected that Peng Hui's body would be found, and that such important evidence would be left behind.
"Sir, this... this is a false accusation! The disciple didn't know Peng Hui at all, and he didn't arrange for him to attack the mission team! "Nie Yongqiang pretended to be calm and tried to quibble.
Shui Qingyang also quickly agreed: "Yes, Your Majesty! This must be someone deliberately framed and trying to sow discord between the disciples and the sect! "
